name: Multi-View Photometric Shape Prediction
aliases: Latent Code Optimization via Photometric Warping
definition: Predicts 3D shape from multiple color images by minimizing cross-view photometric consistency loss without requiring segmentation masks.
summary: Multi-View Photometric Shape Prediction optimizes a latent code to predict 3D shape from color images by minimizing cross-view photometric consistency, avoiding segmentation masks and encoder-based initialization.
